plan.summary: Phase 1 of a phased UI modernization of the Astro + React 19 + Tailwind 3 app in ui/. Add a design-token foundation (Inter font, semantic CSS variables, light/dark theme), small accessible UI primitives (Button, Card, Badge, Skeleton) in the shadcn/Radix style, a modern fintech app shell (sticky header with a working mobile menu, privacy toggle and theme toggle), a redesigned Summary KPI section, skeleton loading, and a restyled BaseModal. Existing chart dashboards, services and lib logic stay untouched. Later phases are out of scope.
plan.understanding: After Phase 1 the home page looks like a professional finance dashboard. It has a clean sticky header with brand, nav, privacy toggle and light/dark toggle. The summary uses KPI cards with semantic green/red profit indicators and tabular numerals. Skeleton placeholders replace the spinner, and all modals share one polished shell. Data fetching, privacy mode, routing under base /invest-track/ and the chart dashboards behave exactly as before.
assumptions: Stack decisions were delegated to us: keep Astro + React + Tailwind 3 (no framework migration), add clsx, tailwind-merge and class-variance-authority for primitives, and keep @heroicons/react for icons. Radix is not added in Phase 1, to keep dependencies minimal.

Keep the current dashboards the same means ForecastGraphModal, CombinedForecastGraphModal, InvestmentGraphModal and ChartUtils chart config/data are not changed; they only inherit the new BaseModal chrome.
Delivery is per phase; this plan covers Phase 1 only.
Dark mode uses Tailwind darkMode 'class', persisted in localStorage with prefers-color-scheme fallback, applied by an inline script in Layout.astro to avoid a flash.
Inter is self-hosted/system-fallback via CSS font stack to avoid a network dependency; if a package is needed, @fontsource-variable/inter is used.
The test runner is node --test on src/**/*.test.js, so only pure JS logic gets unit tests; components are verified via npm run build.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build in ui/ exits 0 and npm test passes, including all existing tests.
tailwind.config.mjs defines darkMode 'class' and semantic color tokens backed by CSS variables in src/styles/global.css for both light and dark themes.
Header renders brand, Home/About links with the active state, PrivacyToggle and ThemeToggle; the mobile menu opens and closes via a button with aria-expanded updated.
Toggling the theme adds or removes the 'dark' class on html and persists the choice in localStorage; reload keeps it with no flash.
Summary shows 4 KPI cards (Invested, Obtained, Benefit, Profit) for total and for organic (collapsible), with profit and benefit colored by sign, and values masked when privacy mode is on.
While loading, Home renders skeleton placeholders instead of LoadingSpinner.
BaseModal keeps the same props (children, onClose, maxWidth), closes on Escape and backdrop click, has role='dialog' and aria-modal, and all existing modals still open and close.
No chart component or lib service file is modified except for the new theme utility.

tasks.title: Add styling utility dependencies
tasks.description: Add clsx, tailwind-merge and class-variance-authority to ui/package.json dependencies with pinned caret versions, then update the lockfile. Add src/lib/cn.js (NEW) exporting cn(...inputs) combining clsx and twMerge.

tasks.title: Design tokens and Tailwind theme
tasks.description: Define CSS variables (background, foreground, card, muted, border, primary, success, danger, ring, radius) for :root and .dark in global.css. Extend tailwind.config.mjs with darkMode 'class', the token colors, Inter font family, and fadeIn keyframes (global.css may already be used by the animate-fadeIn class; keep it working).

tasks.title: Theme utility with tests
tasks.description: Create src/lib/theme.js (NEW) with pure functions getStoredTheme, resolveTheme(stored, prefersDark), applyTheme(theme, root) and THEME_STORAGE_KEY, with storage and root injected for testability. Add src/lib/__tests__/theme.test.js (NEW) using node:test, covering stored value, system fallback, invalid stored value, and class toggling. Place helpers at the end of the file, use explicit imports, and use var in function bodies.

tasks.title: UI primitives
tasks.description: Create NEW components in src/components/ui/: Button.jsx (cva variants), Card.jsx (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent), Badge.jsx (success/danger/neutral), Skeleton.jsx. All use cn and the token classes.

tasks.title: App shell: Layout, Header, ThemeToggle
tasks.description: Layout.astro: add an inline no-flash theme script, Inter font, token body classes, and a meta theme-color. Header.astro: remove the duplicated desktop/mobile link markup by using a single links array, make it sticky with a blur and token styling, fix the mobile toggle with aria-expanded, and add ThemeToggle. Create ThemeToggle.jsx (NEW), modeled on PrivacyToggle.jsx, using theme.js and heroicons Sun/Moon. Restyle PrivacyToggle.jsx to match.

tasks.title: Dashboard home: summary and loading
tasks.description: Rewrite Summary.jsx as KPI cards using Card/Badge with sign-colored benefit and profit, tabular-nums, and a collapsible organic section; keep props (summary, isPrivate) and formatValueForPrivacy. Replace LoadingSpinner usage in Home.jsx with a skeleton layout (also restyle LoadingSpinner.jsx and AIMessage.jsx with tokens). Remove the console.log in Home. Do not change data fetching or the dashboards.

tasks.title: Modal shell
tasks.description: Restyle BaseModal.jsx with token classes, backdrop blur, role='dialog', aria-modal, Escape-to-close, body scroll lock and an open animation, keeping the existing props API so all modals work unchanged. Lightly restyle ModalHeader.jsx. Do not touch the chart modals' content.

tasks.title: Verify
tasks.description: Run npm test and npm run build in ui/, fix failures, and grep for leftover dark-mode-less hardcoded white/gray classes in touched files only.

unitTests: theme.test.js: resolveTheme returns stored 'dark'/'light', falls back to the system preference, and ignores invalid stored values
theme.test.js: applyTheme adds or removes the 'dark' class on a fake root and persists to a fake storage
Existing ForecastUtils, ChartUtils and datetimeFormater tests stay green and unmodified
integrationTests: npm run build validates that all Astro pages and React components compile with the new Tailwind config
e2eChecks: Manual or dev-server probe: load /invest-track/ and verify header, theme toggle persistence, privacy masking, skeleton and summary cards, and that existing modals open and close

conventionNotes: AGENTS.md: explicit imports only, no wildcard imports, including in tests.
AGENTS.md: use var for local variables inside methods, not for class fields or method parameters.
AGENTS.md: test helper methods go at the end of the test file; run the test suite after creating or modifying any test.
AGENTS.md: create tests for new classes following the existing test pattern (node:test in src/lib/__tests__).
Global testing: deterministic tests with injected storage and root; never weaken or skip existing tests.
Global rules: no hardcoded secrets or environment URLs; new dependencies justified in risks; English identifiers and comments.
Java conventions and Lombok rules are not applicable to the ui/ package.
outOfScope: Changing chart/dashboard components or their data (ForecastGraphModal, CombinedForecastGraphModal, InvestmentGraphModal, ChartUtils)
Phase 2+: investment detail page (Investment.jsx, InvestmentStats, entries table/mobile, forecast section), Details list, and form modals restyle
Migrating to Tailwind 4, Next.js or another framework, or adding TypeScript across the codebase
Backend (Java) changes, API contract changes, and new component test infrastructure (e.g. Vitest or Playwright)

risks.description: New dependencies clsx, tailwind-merge and class-variance-authority (small, widely used, no runtime peers) are added.
risks.mitigation: Pin caret versions, add only these three, and justify them in the PR description.

risks.description: Changing global CSS and Tailwind tokens could unintentionally alter chart modals or untouched pages.
risks.mitigation: Only add tokens and keep existing utility classes working. Use dark classes only in restyled files, and check that the chart modals still render.

risks.description: Dark mode may produce unreadable ApexCharts or Recharts on untouched components.
risks.mitigation: Chart containers keep white card backgrounds until their phase, or the dark theme is gated to restyled surfaces; document the known limitation.

risks.description: The theme flash or SSR mismatch occurs because pages use client:only React.
risks.mitigation: Apply the theme class through an inline head script before paint.

risks.description: No component test infrastructure exists, so visual regressions are not caught automatically.
risks.mitigation: Gate on npm run build, keep logic in pure testable modules, and do manual checks on the dev server.

plan.commitMessage: feat(ui): add design tokens, dark mode and modern app shell
